339-677-7297-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-7297-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-6633-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-6633-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

245-851-2034.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

141-2034-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4681-5170-6634-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2738-4050-5687.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding {B}.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it and Skittering Precursor trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a token.
Activate that token by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding {B}.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate that Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

872-2137-7857.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
872-2137-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
872-2137-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand for which legal target(s) exist, if applicable.
872-2137-7857.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control from the battlefield to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery spell.
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

338-1379-2685-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1379-2685-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3499-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-3499-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7650-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7650-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

713-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

2604-4955-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken colorless creature.
2604-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the colorless creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Grafted Wargear's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Ugin.
Repeat.

864-2103-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2906-6072-7182.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 4 life this turn.
2906-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

985-2757-3459-5078.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Battered Golem, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6155-6754.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6155-6754.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

147-2921-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2921-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

1339-1479-3756-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
1339-1479-3756-6674.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Rydia trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1251-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1251-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1116-2999-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-2999-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

575-897-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2101-3883-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Dakra Mystic.
Dakra Mystic does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
2101-3883-4222.description:
Activate Dakra Mystic by paying {U} and tapping it, causing each player to revel the top card of their library, then causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Dakra Mystic.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

405-560-2232-2757.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Soldier token, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining Soldier token.
Repeat from step 1.

1150-2018-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Melira's Keepers, adding one mana of any color.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Repeat.

13-1624.notablePrerequisites: You have an odd life total.
13-1624.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Selenia by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have one life.
Resolve the first Selenia trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
All remaining Selenia triggers fail to resolve due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1987-2427-3227-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

411-3101.manaNeeded: {2}{R} plus an additional amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin
411-3101.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.
